verdict.rationale: The only evidence of user-defined, event-triggered automation is AWS Budgets. A budget threshold (actual or forecasted spend) can automatically apply an action, such as attaching an IAM policy that blocks further provisioning. This is a real, first-party rule-to-action capability, but it is narrow and cost-specific. Nothing in the pack documents a general event-rule engine. Lambda appears only as 'run code without thinking about servers', with no mention of event triggers. Missing for 10: a general-purpose event-rule/routing service across AWS events, documented event sources and action targets beyond budget thresholds, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: you could automatically apply a custom IAM policy that denies you the ability to provision additional resources within an account.
